text: Eating well, moving your body, and getting enough rest are the cornerstones of a healthy life. A balanced diet rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains gives you steady energy, while regular exercise—even a daily thirty-minute walk—strengthens your heart and lifts your mood. But true health isn’t only physical. Prioritizing mental health through mindfulness or hobbies reduces stress, and getting seven to eight hours of quality sleep helps your brain recharge. Equally important is work-life balance: set boundaries between your job and personal time to prevent burnout. Small, consistent habits, not drastic changes, lead to lasting well-being.
